facts.value: Entry initializes the float countdown and selects HammerLanding using flags from ftCo_800C54C4. Ft_MF_KeepFastFall is passed as allow_interrupt=true, not as motion flags; the derived flags do not include KeepFastFall, so Fighter_ChangeMotionState clears fall_fast. Anim runs Hammer maintenance, enters HammerWait for a nonpositive countdown, and then decrements the storage even after that transition. IASA is an empty callback despite the stored allow_interrupt field.
